headline: IRS ordinance changes, a McLane/Middleton legal invoice, and the FY26 pension statement mailing.
summary: The meeting will cover personnel actions, including a retirement and a return of contributions. It will also cover IRS ordinance changes, fund distributions, invoices, and FY26 goals.
items: Personnel: retirement of Michael S. Pinkham
Personnel: return of contributions for Robert M. Leuci
Old business: update ordinance changes for IRS
FY26 Annual Pension Statement mailing discussion, to be passed out in meeting
Approval of distribution of funds for September 1, 2026, through September 30, 2026
Approval of invoice from McLane/Middleton for legal services on ordinance changes for IRS
Approval of USI invoice for pension services
Goals for FY26: IRS changes approved by December 2026; possible RFP for Trustee of Trust Fund Services
location: Mine Falls Conference Room, 848 West Hollis Street, Nashua, NH 03062
